title: Viral Preparation
author: Aditya Mohan
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.8iahuae

steps.title: Coat Plates
steps.instruction: Coat the plates with 1% Poly-L-Lysine solution and leave in a dry incubator overnight.

steps.title: Seed HEK293 T Cells
steps.instruction: Plate 6E6 HEK293 T cells overnight in DMEM media.

steps.title: Prepare Transfection Complexes
steps.instruction: Prepare the lipofectamine and plasmid mixtures in two separate 1.5 mL epindorph tubes using OptiMEM.

substeps.instruction: Add 150 uL of OptiMEM to two 1.5 mL epindorph tubes.
Add 15 uL of lipofectamine to the first tube.
Add 10 uL of packaging plasmid and 10 uL of the plasmid of interest to the second tube.

steps.title: Combine Transfection Mixture
steps.instruction: Combine the contents of the two tubes to a total volume of approximately 300 uL and incubate for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Transfect Cells
steps.instruction: Apply the transfection mixture to the cells and supplement with DMEM.

substeps.instruction: Remove the media from the plate.
Add the 300 uL transfection mixture dropwise.

steps.title: Initial Media Supplementation
steps.instruction: Add 5 mL of DMEM based media to the plate.

steps.title: Collect and Replace Media
steps.instruction: Harvest the media and replenish the cells with fresh DMEM.

substeps.instruction: Remove the media and transfer it to an eppendorf tube stored at 4 °C.
Add another 5 mL of DMEM based media to the plate.
